hook: Sab bol rahe hain MERN Stack outdated ho gaya. But agar aisa hai… toh fir kyun 2024 mein bhi lakhs of Indian startups sirf MERN engineers hi hire kar rahe hain? Let's find out — Code or Cap?
evidence: React (the R in MERN) gets 25M+ npm downloads every week — it is still the most used frontend library on the planet.
Naukri and LinkedIn both show 40,000+ active MERN job listings in India in 2024, so the job market hasn't moved on.
The real weak link is MongoDB — for complex relational data it struggles, and plain JavaScript MERN feels dated compared to TypeScript-first stacks like T3 or Next.js + Prisma.
voiceover: Sab bol rahe hain Mern Stack outdated ho gaya. Phir kyun aaj bhi startups Mern engineers ko hire kar rahe hain? Aaj ka sawaal — Mern Stack Is Outdated. Code hai ya Cap? Fact ek — React 19 aaya 2024 mein, aur 2025 mein 50 million weekly downloads cross kar liye. Abhi bhi number one frontend hai. Fact do — Stack Overflow 2025 survey ke hisaab se, Node.js teen saal se continuously number one technology hai. Mern ki demand ruk nahi rahi. Fact teen — asli shift yeh hai ki teams MongoDB ko PostgreSQL aur Prisma se replace kar rahi hain, lekin React aur Node wahi reh rahe hain. Verdict — Partially True. Mern dead nahi hai, bas modernize karna padega. TypeScript aur PostgreSQL add karo, aur stack bilkul alive hai. Rating hai paanch out of ten. Mixed verdict. youtube_description:
Is the MERN Stack really outdated in 2025? Every developer seems to have an opinion, but what does the data actually say?

In this video, we break down the truth about MERN Stack — React, Express, MongoDB, and Node.js — using the latest data from Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, npm download stats, and real hiring trends.

✅ React 19 crossed 50M+ weekly npm downloads in 2025 — still the most used frontend library on the planet.
✅ Node.js is the #1 used technology for the 3rd consecutive year (Stack Overflow 2025).
⚠️ The real shift: MongoDB is being replaced by PostgreSQL + Prisma, but React and Node are going nowhere.

Verdict: MIXED — MERN's core is very much alive, but the classic MongoDB + plain JavaScript setup is getting replaced by TypeScript-first, PostgreSQL-powered stacks.

Whether you're a fresher deciding what to learn or a mid-level dev questioning your stack — this video has the data-backed answer.
